mentions.name: OpenCharities
mentions.description: A search tool for UK charities that provides quick, clear results across the three separate government organisations that regulate UK charities, uniquely including their regulatory filing PDFs and websites.
mentions.problem: UK charities are regulated by three separate government organisations, each with poor websites, making charity information hard to find in one place.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Charities in the UK are regulated by three separate gov organisations - all with not great websites.

I'm building a quick and clear search across all of them plus, I believe uniquely, their regulatory filing PDFs and websites.
